bottom_line: The stages were last used in 2009, when 12 homes took in water.

headline.dek: Four stages, from a noticeboard watch to evacuation routes.
headline.title: How Fallowfield's flood warning works

steps.text: Warden phones the council; watch posted on the noticeboard
steps.title: River watch

steps.text: Formal warning; the riverside path closes
steps.title: Warning issued

steps.text: 200 sandbags at the community hall; hall opens as a shelter
steps.title: Sandbags and shelter

steps.text: At 4.6 m, 3 routes open out of the riverside streets
steps.title: Evacuation routes

scenes.question: What happens as the river rises?
scenes.why: The story is a procedure in order, with no dates: a chain of stages is the shape, not a timeline and not a set of tiles.
